analysis.prior: Independent family/configuration Jeffreys Beta(.5,.5) frequencies and Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) severity bands. Matched contrasts use joint four-outcome Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) priors, preserving Beta margins.
analysis.scope: Three equally weighted regression-enriched hard families; fresh seed, unchanged generator complexity. Old results are development evidence only and are not pooled. No production traffic claim.
analysis.uncertainty: Marginal Bayesian intervals depend on the stated priors/model and equal family weights. Frequency exact upper bounds allocate 5% over 24 cells. Paired frequency contrast intervals allocate a separate 5% over 36 family/comparison contrasts (144 one-sided endpoints). They require a complete fixed batch, fixed policies and IID pairs within family. Two additional separate 5% families cover 16 arm/stream conditional-dollar sequences and 12 paired-dollar sequences. Together these four frequentist families are not a joint 95% guarantee (union bound at least 80%). Missing responses remain unresolved, excluded from financial estimates and counted as task errors.
analysis.memory_interpretation: Selected memory versus none changes recalled procedural context and the usage contract jointly. Both use the same current records and base policy. No record-calculation report is supplied in this follow-up. A Sonnet critic is a separate request under the same memory condition. Context length, instructions and added critic compute are not independently controlled.
